about_the_game:
Her subjects came to the dwarf queen with alarming news. All neighboring countries have started a big war and the country of the gnomes is unlikely to be able to avoid it!

Court advisers reported that the country was not ready for war and it was necessary to postpone entry into the conflict as long as possible.

Then the queen invites all parties to board their ships and meet in neutral waters for negotiations.

Your loyal subjects are waiting for help! Embark on a new adventure with the heroine and her friends through amazing places: Abandoned Settlements, Dryad's Forest and much more! Mysteries, mystical creatures, mysterious events - all this in the exciting casual fantasy strategy Gnomes Garden: Black Stones. A lot of different tasks, more than 40 levels, an intriguing plot, simple and exciting gameplay and an unusual universe are waiting for you right now.

Gnomes Garden: Black Stones - Help the gnomes defeat evil!

In the game, you will find:

- An unusual magical world, the source of magic of which is ancient gardens.

- Fun plot, colorful comics and bright characters!

- Many different tasks that the queen has not yet encountered.

- More than 40 unique levels.

- Unusual enemies: evil gremlins, angry bears, and... chthonic monsters.

- 4 unique locations: Abandoned settlements, Dryad's Forest, Gloomy Thicket, Valley of Black Stones.

- Useful bonuses: acceleration of time...

- Simple controls and clear training.

- Over 20 hours of addictive gameplay for all ages.

- Nice theme music.
